observed_in: Shop and Economy System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the maximum number of items that can be stored in a shop's inventory, influencing how diverse the offerings are and how often players encounter new items. Variations can be seen in the total item capacity, item types available, and how quickly items refresh in the shop.
exclusion_criteria: does not include the pricing mechanics
does not refer to the types of currency used
inclusion_criteria: defines the variety of items available for purchase
affects the frequency of player interactions with shops
title: Shop Inventory Size
